acs.text: For each exercised testimonial position on `/success-stories`, opening the testimonial's book link loads that testimonial author's book page on the platform.

expected_answer.operand: opened page is the testimonial author's book page on the platform

exercises.rationale: This scenario follows representative testimonial links and proves the destination is the linked author's book page.
The scenario reads each testimonial's displayed author name to compare it with the opened book page.
The scenario requires each exercised testimonial to expose a clickable link to the author's book.
This scenario reviews the page heading on `/success-stories`.
This scenario counts the testimonials shown on the page.
This scenario checks that each testimonial shows a quote.
This scenario checks that each testimonial shows the author's name.
This scenario checks that each testimonial includes a link to the author's book.
This scenario checks that each testimonial shows the package the author used.
